title: The Financial Reset Is Coming. Here's What Happens Next
description:
The President of the United States said out loud how $40 trillion in debt gets paid off. His words to TIME magazine: "certain levels of inflation will also pay off that debt very rapidly." In plain English, the debt doesn't shrink. Your dollars do.

So I go through it piece by piece. The debt nobody can pay, growing by around $6.7 billion a day. How America already inflated a debt away after World War II, and again in 2020. Why the bond market is pushing back. And why inflating debt away on purpose needs an excuse: a crisis where money printing looks like a rescue. That's the reset I've been pondering, and I don't believe it's a matter of if... just when.

When money gets printed into a crisis, the people who already own scarce assets come out the other side even richer. We watched it happen in 2020 and 2021. I happen to think a wave of crypto billionaires gets made starting next year, in scarce assets like $BTC and $KAS. Will you be one of them?
